clergy.vestments: lacquered wooden masks, leafsilk robes, and moon-metal knives
clergy.holy_symbol: painted mask hung from a living branch

practices.dietary_restrictions: no hunted meat during mask festivals

cosmology.opposing_view_detail: Lawful beings are taught to be wood-bleaching jailers who mistake daylight for truth and order for wisdom.
cosmology.notes: See §3.3 Alignment Cosmology Rules for the hard constraints governing this field.

pantheon.domains_summary: Nhali governs disguise, seduction, ritual art, and the truths only falsehood can reveal.

pantheon.holy_symbol: forked antler around a green stone
pantheon.domains_summary: The Hart blesses pursuit, escape, woodland plenty, and the gamble of every arrow loosed unseen.

pantheon.holy_symbol: spiral root over a skull seed
pantheon.domains_summary: Uruun holds the tomb-roots, decaying wisdom, and omens that rise from patient soil.

pantheon.holy_symbol: blue drop inside a black thorn ring
pantheon.domains_summary: She rules ecstatic visions, witchcraft, sleepless terrors, and the dangerous beauty of moonlit thought.

flavor_text.one_line: A woodland faith of masks, ecstatic art, and gods who prefer beautiful disorder to honest obedience.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Masked Greenwood teaches that no soul is single and no true thing can live long under naked scrutiny. Priests dance in lacquered masks, hunters leave painted offerings at moon-trees, and even funerary rites are staged as layered performances for gods, ghosts, and watching kin. It is a generous religion to those who accept mystery and a merciless one toward lumbering certainty.
flavor_text.creation_myth_summary: When the first forest was mute, Nhali painted a face on the moon, and the trees learned to speak in shadows.
flavor_text.moral_code_summary: Protect the wild and the hidden, make beauty from danger, betray tyrants with elegance, and never let law strip a person down to one permitted face.
